words.prose: {{ar:سُطِحَتْ}} ({{tr:suṭiḥat}}) is the ayah's final result-word. As a passive perfect, it presents the earth as already made into an exposed surface while leaving the maker unspoken inside the clause. Its feminine singular ending ties the result back to {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}), so the fronted target becomes the acted-upon domain. The root's surface branch makes the ground more than broad extension: it becomes a made upper face and usable plane for sight, bodies, and movement, while V4 keeps unrelated flat-object branches from being imported as local senses. Variant and parallel evidence sharpens the point: active-agent and intensified-passive readings show what the base passive does not foreground, and spread-support parallels (51:48; 71:19; 2:22; 78:6) clarify that 88:20 turns provision into an inspectable surface-state. Its rare surface-making form also makes common earth feel newly strange, joins the prior passive result-cadence of the survey, and leaves the completed surface-sign ready to ground the reminder command in 88:21.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The earth at word 2 is joined to the passive surfacing verb at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: The lower member opposite the sky is acted upon by spreading, extending, and leveling, yielding a broad traversable plane.

activation_trace.role: The lower ground opposite the sky supplies the vertically low substrate being considered.
A level extended surface supplies the passive operation that makes the substrate broad and even.

changed_reading.before: A question about the earth's shape.
changed_reading.after: A question about the making of the lower realm into an extended, usable plane.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The earth noun and surfacing verb both carry branches involving mats or useful flat places.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two roots converge on a spread deliberately laid and prepared for use, so the verse can evoke site preparation rather than geometry alone.

activation_trace.role: The thick hair-or-wool mat makes the earth available as a deliberately laid spread.
The flat working place or woven mat gives the spread a practical, prepared function.

changed_reading.before: The earth is merely a naturally flat expanse.
changed_reading.after: The earth is a prepared floor or spread arranged for creatures to use.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The earth at word 2 can be fertile ground, while the surfacing root at word 4 can describe vegetation spreading along ground.
baseline_models.mechanism: Surfacing can be read dynamically as making a receptive plane across which rooted life establishes and extends itself.

activation_trace.role: Soft fertile ground supplies receptivity, establishment, and productive growth.
A plant spreading along the ground turns extension into a living process across the surface.

changed_reading.before: Surfacing is a one-time physical flattening.
changed_reading.after: Surfacing is also the making of a receptive, growth-bearing field.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The earth root can pull a body downward, and the surfacing root can picture a body laid flat on the ground.
baseline_models.mechanism: The passive verb permits a bodily analogy in which the earth is itself laid out, or becomes the plane on which a body is laid low.

activation_trace.role: Sticking to the ground and being slow to rise supplies the earthward pull of the bodily image.
A body laid out flat through incapacity supplies the surprising prone analogue for the passive verb.

changed_reading.before: Only an impersonal landscape is spread out.
changed_reading.after: The landscape can also register the vulnerable image of a body laid low or a ground that receives such bodies.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening couples manifestation with a cover that overtops and conceals. Against that pair, the focus surface becomes an interface: an exposed plane through which a hidden or covered order becomes inspectable.

activation_trace.role: The lower ground supplies the material side of the exposed interface.
The level top plane supplies the visible side of what has been surfaced.
Making something manifest supplies disclosure across the interface.
A cover lying above and hiding its object supplies the occluding layer opposed to exposure.
The non-dominant mapped inventory independently supplies concealment, preserving the split-root activation.

structural_cues: The surah opens with a report of an all-covering event before moving toward inspectable created forms.
The passive focus verb leaves the maker implicit and foregrounds the resulting visible interface.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies manifestation and covering; I infer that a surface mediates what is hidden and what can be seen. A live alternative is simple horizontal extension with no concealment mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The surface is only the earth's flat top.
changed_reading.after: The surface is the earth's exposed interface, making an otherwise covered order available to attention.

context_deltas.mechanism: Lowered faces, purposive labor, and exhaustion turn the focus-only prone-body branch into a coherent downward sequence: effort spends the body until it is flattened against the earth.

activation_trace.role: Clinging to the ground and failing to rise supplies the endpoint of bodily depletion.
The incapacitated body laid flat supplies the focus's bodily surface image.
Low dormant earth materially joins human abasement to a groundward condition.
Intentional work supplies the exertion that precedes collapse.
Weariness that debilitates a person supplies the causal pressure toward being laid low.

structural_cues: Human faces and working bodies are described before the later sequence of passively formed landscape members.
The focus's passive morphology can hold both a land-making event and the state of something laid out.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies low dormant earth, work, and debilitating weariness; I map their downward vector onto the focus branch of a prone body. The live alternative keeps the human scene and the later landscape entirely separate.

changed_reading.before: The prone-body branch is an isolated lexical curiosity.
changed_reading.after: The spread earth can echo bodily exhaustion and the terminal posture of being brought low.

context_deltas.mechanism: Water delivery, plant output, failed sufficiency, soft well-being, and a flowing spring convert the fertile baseline into a provisioning system. The earth is surfaced so water and growth can circulate, yet the context preserves the possibility of a surface that produces without nourishing.

activation_trace.role: Soft fertile ground supplies the receptive and productive medium.
Ground-spreading vegetation supplies the living extension across that medium.
An apportioned irrigation flow supplies a water-delivery channel for the field.
The named plant supplies an actual surface output whose nourishment can be tested.
Sufficiency supplies the functional criterion that distinguishes productive appearance from sustaining yield.
Softness and ease supply the positive bodily result of a well-provisioned environment.
A spring supplies a point source from which surface fertility can be renewed.
Flowing and coursing supply circulation rather than stagnant possession of water.

structural_cues: Verses 5-7 present water and plant-food that fail to sustain; verses 8-12 reverse toward softness and a running spring.
The focus gathers these contrasting outcomes under the final ground member of the created-form sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies water channels, a plant, sufficiency, softness, a spring, and flow; I infer that leveling enables their ecological coordination. A live alternative confines those images to two afterlife settings without carrying them into the earth's making.

changed_reading.before: The earth is a passive geometric expanse.
changed_reading.after: The earth is an engineered provisioning field whose surface mediates water, growth, and the difference between mere yield and true sustenance.

context_deltas.mechanism: A sequence of resting places, deliberate placement, linear arrangement, and spreading furnishes a habitation at small scale. It activates the focus's two mat-like branches at cosmic scale, making the earth a floor prepared for ordered use.

activation_trace.role: The thick mat supplies the earth-sized furnishing on which the model turns.
The useful flat place or woven mat supplies preparation for work, rest, and placement.
A place of settling and reclining supplies the habitation's resting function.
Putting an object in a lower or appointed place supplies deliberate positioning on the floor.
Alignment on a level line supplies ordered arrangement across the prepared plane.
Dispersing and spreading supplies the final act of furnishing the available area.

structural_cues: Verses 13-16 move through elevated resting places, placed vessels, aligned cushions, and spread carpets immediately before the inspection sequence.
The focus concludes that inspection sequence with the only member that can function as the shared floor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rest, placement, alignment, and spreading; I scale that arrangement from an interior to the landscape. A live alternative treats the adjacency as descriptive rhythm without a functional analogy.

changed_reading.before: The earth is spread only to describe its extent.
changed_reading.after: The earth is spread as a cosmic furnishing: a deliberately prepared common floor.

context_deltas.mechanism: Directed observation, an embodied creature requiring care, measured creation, and a creation-branch explicitly involving smoothness revise extension into calibrated affordance. The ground and the creature can be read as mutually fitted rather than separately displayed.

activation_trace.role: The lower ground supplies the creature's contact and travel substrate.
Level extension supplies the broad physical affordance to be calibrated.
Directing sight or insight supplies examination of functional fit rather than passive noticing.
The camel together with its care supplies an embodied user of the habitat.
Measuring and proportioning supply deliberate calibration in the making process.
Smoothness and evenness of a surface directly bridge creature-creation language to the focus operation.

structural_cues: Verses 17-20 repeat one directional, interrogative, passive frame; the branchless root ك ي ف is used only as this structural cue.
The sequence moves from creature to overhead cover, upright masses, and ground.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies directed inspection, camel care, proportioning, and surface evenness; I infer a design relation between creature and ground. A live alternative takes each created item as an independent sign with no habitat-level coupling.

changed_reading.before: Leveling gives the earth a generic physical shape.
changed_reading.after: Leveling calibrates the earth as an embodied habitat, fitted to movement, care, and use.

context_deltas.mechanism: An overhead cover is raised, hard masses are erected, and the lower member is extended. These are complementary operations in one vertical architecture, so surfacing names the horizontal role of earth within a coordinated system.

activation_trace.role: The lower ground opposite the sky supplies the system's bottom member.
Level extension supplies the horizontal operation complementary to raising and erecting.
What rises and shades supplies an overhead covering member.
Lifting something upward supplies the operation that establishes the top member.
A high solid aggregation supplies resistant vertical mass between sky and ground.
Setting something upright and prominent supplies the operation that establishes the vertical masses.

structural_cues: The same directional and passive syntax coordinates sky, mountains, and earth.
The operations differ by member: raising above, erecting vertically, and extending below.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an overhead cover, upward lifting, solid height, upright erection, lower ground, and level extension; I assemble them into a spatial system. A live alternative reads the list as independent marvels without architectural interdependence.

changed_reading.before: The earth's flatness is an isolated proposition.
changed_reading.after: The earth's extension is its relational job as the lower horizontal member of a raised and erected world.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ground's made surface is offered to directed attention, then the discourse moves to reminding while denying controlling surveillance. The focus therefore works as accessible mnemonic evidence rather than a proposition imposed by force.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary lower ground supplies evidence continuously available to embodied observers.
The broad visible plane supplies the inspectable form that can prompt recollection.
Directed sight or insight supplies the observer's active engagement with the sign.
A reminder that causes recollection supplies the pedagogical function of the visible surface.
The controlling overseer supplies the coercive mode explicitly denied after the reminder.

structural_cues: The repeated branchless interrogative root in verses 17-20 sustains process-focused attention without supplying a branch citation.
The command to remind and denial of control immediately follow the earth question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies observation, reminder, and denied control; I assign the visible surface a mnemonic rather than coercive function. A live alternative limits the non-control statement to the messenger and gives it no bearing on how the earth question operates.

changed_reading.before: The verse asserts a fact about terrain.
changed_reading.after: The verse makes the familiar ground into an open-ended visual reminder whose process must be attended to rather than compelled as a conclusion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same material act of covering can hide truth or protect seed until growth emerges. Joined to fertile earth and a ground-spreading plant, this makes the surfaced earth a test case in morally and causally divergent concealment.

activation_trace.role: Fertile ground supplies the medium in which concealment can become germination.
Vegetation spreading visibly over the ground supplies the disclosed result of productive covering.
Turning away supplies the directional refusal that converts concealment into evasion.
Hiding truth supplies the epistemically destructive form of covering.
Covering seed supplies the materially productive form of the same action.

structural_cues: The discourse moves directly from looking and reminding to turning away and covering.
The focus surface is both what covers depth and where buried growth becomes visible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fertile ground, spreading growth, turning away, truth-concealment, and seed-covering; I infer a contrast between generative and evasive concealment. A live alternative treats the agricultural branch as an etymological side image with no role in the focus.

changed_reading.before: The earth's surface simply lies above what is beneath it.
changed_reading.after: The earth's surface dramatizes two kinds of cover: one that incubates emergence and one that suppresses recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: A flat working place, purposeful earning, return to a destination, and final counting produce a temporal-social reading: the earth is the prepared arena on which striving is enacted before its yield returns to account.

activation_trace.role: The level working place supplies the terrestrial arena for repeated action.
Work, earning, and active disposal supply what agents produce on the arena.
Return to a destination supplies closure to the period of terrestrial movement.
Counting and accounting supply evaluation of what the arena's striving yielded.

structural_cues: The surah names striving before the focus and closes after it with return and accounting.
The focus's practical-place branch allows spatial preparation to acquire a bounded temporal use.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a working surface, earning, return, and calculation; I connect them as arena, action, closure, and evaluation. A live alternative keeps the earth purely physical and locates return explicitly beyond rather than back into that arena.

changed_reading.before: The prepared earth is useful but temporally neutral.
changed_reading.after: The prepared earth is a bounded field of striving whose uses and yields stand before return and account.

Downstream prose should label it a split-root, cross-domain activation rather than a direct gloss of the focus verb.

The non-dominant mapping's first rain marks the earth with vegetation, supplying the initial inscription.

changed_reading.after: The earth's visible face is repeatedly written into being by rain and the vegetation that follows.

Downstream prose should present it as a ledger analogy, not as a lexical translation.

changed_reading.after: The earth can be imagined as a legible working surface on which action leaves ordered traces available to account.

strongest_changes: The furnishing sequence recast passive leveling as preparation of a cosmic floor for ordered use.
The water, plant, sufficiency, and spring sequence strengthened the earth into a provisioning field rather than a geometric object.
The repeated created-form frame made surfacing both a calibrated habitat operation and the earth's horizontal role in a vertical architecture.
Observation, reminder, denied control, and divergent covering made the visible surface epistemically active without collapsing its material readings.
summary.what_was_special: The rare surfacing root carried branches for an extended plane, practical mat, ground-spreading plant, prone body, and structural support. Context activated several of these at once without forcing a single final reading; the split sky mapping and following-rain branch also opened a contained image of a rain-written surface.

Whether the body-earth lowering relation is intended or remains branch-driven resonance.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Earth as lower plane spread for use.** Evidence: `ء ر ض` B001 lower ground opposite sky; `س ط ح` B001 flat extended surface. `ك ي ف` has no branch inventory. Structural cue: the inspection sequence descends from camel to sky, mountains, earth; this line completes the spatial frame. Role: earth is the usable lower surface, not inert backdrop. Abductive move: the created world is readable as arranged planes and supports. Reading change: the ayah reads as attention to habitability and extension.

2. **Fertile ground beneath the pastoral signs.** Evidence: `ء ر ض` B002 soft fertile ground; `س ط ح` B006 plant spreading along ground; earlier `ض ر ع` plant, `ن ع م` livestock, `ء ب ل` camels. Structural cue: food/pasture and camel imagery culminate in earth’s surface. Role: the spread earth is the base for pasture and provision. Abductive move: nourishment depends on the relation between water, animal, plant, and ground. Reading change: earth’s flattening becomes ecological preparation.

3. **Flattening as reversal of bodies laid low.** Evidence: `س ط ح` B002 body laid flat on ground; `خ ش ع` B002 low ground; earlier faces humbled. Structural cue: punished faces are lowered; earth is spread. Role: the same flatness can be ordered ground or defeated body. Abductive move: moral reading distinguishes beneficial leveling from humiliating collapse. Reading change: `سطحت` is not simply flattening; it is purposeful surface-making.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The garden carpets in 88:16 had already prepared a small-scale version of spread surface, so the earth appeared as cosmic furnishing. The bodily branch of `س ط ح` also sent a shadow back to the humbled faces.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The earth is the lower, usable plane in a relational construction.** **Lexical:** `ء ر ض` B001, "the lower ground opposite the sky," and `س ط ح` B001, "a flat extended surface." **Cue:** raised sky in 88:18, upright mountains in 88:19, and surfaced earth in 88:20 form a repeated passive `كَيْفَ` series. **Role:** earth supplies the lower counterpart, surfacing supplies extension, and the neighboring objects establish its vertical and interruptive relations. **Abduction:** I infer that habitability emerges from these relations, not from flatness alone. **Reading change:** the earth reads as a deliberately coordinated working plane within an upper-middle-lower system.

2. **The spread carpets activate a textile analogy for the surfaced earth.** **Lexical:** `ء ر ض` B005, "the thick mat," and `س ط ح` B005, "a flat working place or mat," activated with B001. **Cue:** `زَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ` in 88:16 precedes the world-observation sequence, while 88:20 uses passive surfacing. **Role:** the carpet supplies a familiar prepared surface; earth and `سطح` branches enlarge that material logic to the inhabited world. **Abduction:** I infer that the earlier furnishing is an analogy rather than merely nearby decoration. **Reading change:** the earth becomes a vast laid-out support, prepared for dwelling and action as a carpeted place is prepared for use.

3. **A tent-like architectural model links support, cover, and floor.** **Lexical:** `س ط ح` B003, "a support that stretches out a tent," alongside B001; `ء ر ض` B001 supplies the floor. **Cue:** the sky is raised as overhead cover, mountains stand upright, and earth is extended beneath them in 88:18-20. **Role:** the support branch assigns the upright middle forms a possible stretching function between cover and floor. **Abduction:** I infer a tent analogy; the packet gives no claim that mountains literally hold the sky. **Reading change:** `سطحت` participates in a coherent architectural image: an extended floor beneath a raised covering articulated by standing supports.

4. **The ground is not the final destination of directed movement.** **Lexical:** `ء ر ض` B001, lower ground, and B006, sticking to the ground and lingering; `س ط ح` B001 supplies extension. **Cue:** the gaze is directed `إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ`, but 88:25 later redirects the people themselves `إِلَيْنَا` in return. **Role:** the earth receives sight and bodily movement as a surface, while the return statement prevents it from becoming the terminal point. **Abduction:** I infer a correction from repeated directional syntax. **Reading change:** the surfaced earth is a traversable and inspectable plane, not an ultimate place in which persons can simply remain.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 88:21 turned the surfaced earth from a passive object into evidence used by reminder. The strongest later surprise was 88:25's `إِلَيْنَا`: it folds the earlier outward `إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ` back toward the observer's own return, correcting the earth from final destination to traversed surface.

findings.text: Yer, gök ve dağlarla birlikte kurulan üst-orta-alt düzeninin yaşanabilir, uzanmış çalışma düzlemidir.
Kalın yaygı ve çalışma hasırı çağrışımları, serilmiş halıları dünya ölçeğine çıkararak yeri oturma ve eylem için hazırlanmış büyük bir destek gibi gösterir.
Çadırı geren destek çağrışımı, göğü örtü, dağları dikili ara parçalar ve yeri taban olarak birleştiren mimari bir benzetme önerir.
Yerde oyalanıp kalma ihtimali, sonradan bildirilen ilahi dönüşle düzeltilir: Yer üzerinde yürünüp incelenen bir yüzeydir, nihai varış noktası değildir.
Yumuşak verimli toprak ve yerde yayılan bitki çağrışımları, düzleştirmeyi su, otlak, hayvan ve beslenme ilişkisine hazırlanmış ekolojik bir taban yapar.
Yere serilmiş beden çağrışımı, önceki alçaltılmış yüzlerin aksine burada düzlüğün yenilgi değil, yararlı bir yüzey kurma işi olduğunu gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, göğün karşısında aşağıda bulunan ve üzerinde yaşanan yeri temel anlam olarak verir; nesnelerin yere bakan altı ile hayvan ayağının alt bölümü de buna bağlı kullanımlardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın yer anlamını kapsar; alt bölüm ve hayvan ayağı anlamlarını ise yalnız belirtilen tamlamalara bağlı yan yüzler olarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Göğün karşısında aşağıda bulunan, üzerinde yaşadığımız yer küresini belirtir. Belirli tamlamalarda bir şeyin yere bakan altını ve hayvanın tırnağını ya da ayağının alt bölümünü de anlatır.

facets.statement: Göğün karşısında aşağıda bulunan ve üzerinde yaşanan yer küresidir.
Bir şeyin yere bakan alt bölümü, belirli bir tamlama içinde bu adla anılır.
Hayvanın tırnağı veya ayağının yere değen alt bölümü için kullanılan özel bir tamlama vardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, anlamın merkezinde göğün karşısındaki aşağı yerin bulunduğunu; alt bölüm ve hayvan ayağı kullanımlarının bu mekansal çekirdeğe dayandığını birlikte gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: yer ve yere bakan alt bölüm
concept_gloss.applicability: Yer küresi anlamını ve ona bağlı alt bölüm yönelimini birlikte özetleyen en kısa doğal karşılıktır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, nitelikli toprak anlamını yalnız kanıtlanan tamlamalara; bitki, fidan ve oğlakla ilgili anlamları da kendi kanıtlanmış yapılarına bağlar.

concept_map.definition: Belirtilen yapılarda yumuşak, iyi, verimli ve bol bitki yetiştiren toprağı anlatır. Buna bağlı yapılarda bitkinin toprağa iyice yerleşip çoğalması veya biçilebilir olması, köklü fidan ve yer bitkisini yiyen oğlak; ayrı bir kaynak kullanımında ise semiz oğlak ifade edilir.

facets.statement: Toprak veya çayırlık yumuşak, verimli ve iyi bitki yetiştirir.
Bitki toprağa iyice yerleşir, çoğalır veya biçilecek olgunluğa ulaşır.
Oğlak yer bitkisini yer.
Bir kaynakta ilgili niteleme semiz oğlağı belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Birleşik kanıt, verimli ve yumuşak toprağı; bu toprakta gelişen bitkiyi ve bitkiden yararlanan oğlağı aynı üretkenlik ilişkisi içinde toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın toprak niteliğine dayanan çekirdeğini eksiksiz ve doğal biçimde karşılar.

branches.source_phrase_ar: المسطح والمسطحة شبه مطهرة ليست بمربعة؛ الكوز ذو الجنب الواحد مسطح (ayn;tahdhib)؛ السطيحة أديمان يتخذ منهما مزادة (jamhara)؛ السطيحة والسطيح المزادة (sihah)؛ السطيحة المزادة وإنما سميت بذلك لأنه إذا سقط انسطح (maqayis)؛ السطيحة من المزاد إذا كانت من جلدين (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir nesne türünü değil, aynı adla anılan üç ayrı referenti verir: hurmanın kurutulduğu düz yer, su toplayan geniş kaya yüzü ve hurma yaprağından örülmüş hasır. Dal korunabilir, ancak bu kullanımların tek bir nesne gibi kaynaştırılmaması ve düz ya da yayvan yüzey ortaklığı altında alternatifler olarak gösterilmesi gerekir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım bağımsız adın üç ayrı referentini açıkça sıralar; bunları genel düz yer, genel su haznesi ya da genel hasır anlamına genişletmez.

concept_map.definition: Aynı ad, hurmanın serilip kurutulduğu düz yere, yağmur suyunun biriktiği çevresi taşla çevrili geniş kaya yüzüne ve hurma yaprağından örülmüş hasıra verilir; bunlar tek nesne değil, düz ya da yayvan yüzey ortaklığı taşıyan ayrı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Düz ya da yayvan bir yüzeyden yararlanılan yer ve nesnelere uzanan çok anlamlı bir addır.
Hurmanın serilip güneşte kurutulduğu düz yerdir.
Çevresi taşla çevrilerek yağmur suyunun biriktirildiği geniş kaya yüzüdür.
Hurma ağacı yapraklarından örülen bir hasırdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt, aynı bağımsız ad altında üç ayrı kullanım verir: kurutma yeri, su biriktiren geniş kaya yüzü ve örme hasır. Bunlar düz ya da yayvan yüzey görünümüyle bağlantılı olsa da ayrı referentlerdir.

concept_gloss.text: düz kurutma yeri, su toplayan kaya yüzü veya hasır
concept_gloss.applicability: Aynı adın üç ayrı referentini tek bir üst kategoriye indirgemeden alternatifler halinde gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Kurutma yerini, su toplayan kaya yüzünü ve hasırı ayrı ayrı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hurmaların serilip güneşte kurutulduğu düz ve hazırlanmış yer kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Düz yeri, hurmanın serilmesini ve kurutma amacını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Çevresi taşlarla sınırlandırılmış geniş kaya yüzünde yağmur suyu biriktiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Geniş kaya yüzünü, çevre sınırını ve su biriktirme işlevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hurma ağacı yapraklarının örülmesiyle yapılan hasır kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hasır oluşunu, bitkisel malzemeyi ve örme yapımını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hurma kurutma amacı ile su toplayan kaya yüzü ve örme hasır anlamlarını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Açık avlu, düz arazi ve pürüzsüz yer yüzeyi gibi genel mekanları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da düz ve açık bir yer yüzeyini adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel bir açık ya da düz yerdir; bu dalın yer anlamı hurma kurutma işleviyle sınırlıdır ve ayrıca iki ayrı nesne anlamı taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli biçimde hurma yaprağından örülen hasırı, ayrıca iki yer anlamını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Malzemesi belirtilmeyen genel döşek, yaygı ve hasır alanını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yere serilebilen bir hasır ya da yaygıyı adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yalnızca belirli bitkisel malzemeden örülen hasır kullanımına sahiptir; komşu dal daha genel bir yaygı ve döşek kategorisidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Düz yer kullanımını hurma kurutma amacıyla sınırlar ve kaya yüzü ile hasır anlamlarını da taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Herhangi bir özel kullanım amacı olmadan düz taban ya da düz yer anlamındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da düz bir zemin ya da yer parçasını anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal biçimsel olarak düz yeri adlandırır; bu dalın yer anlamı belirli bir kurutma işlevine bağlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Suyu geniş bir kaya yüzünde, çevresine taş dizerek biriktirir ve başka iki yüzey anlamını da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kazılmış çukur, kuyu ve üstü örtülü yakalama çukuru biçimlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da suyun ya da başka bir şeyin biriktiği sınırlı bir yer oluşturabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal kazılmış ya da çukur bir yapıdır; bu dalın su biriktirme kullanımı geniş kaya yüzünün çevresini taşla sınırlamaya dayanır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; üç referentin her biriyle doğrudan sınır karşılaştırması sağlayan düz yer, hasır, düz taban ve su biriktiren çukur adayları seçildi.
branches.branch_image_ar: موضع أو بساط مسطح ينتفع به
branches.what_is_ar: المسطح موضع مستو يبسط عليه التمر ليجف، أو صفاة عريضة يجتمع فيها الماء، أو حصير مسفوف من خوص الدوم
branches.source_phrase_ar: المسطح الموضع الذي يجفف ويبسط فيه التمر (jamhara;sihah;maqayis)؛ المسطح مكان مستو يجفف عليه التمر ويسمى الجرين (tahdhib)؛ المسطح الصفاة يحاط عليها بالحجارة فيجتمع فيها الماء (sihah)؛ صفيحة عريضة من الصخر يحوط عليه لماء السماء (tahdhib)؛ المسطح حصير يسف من خوص الدوم (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı yere yayılarak büyüyen belirli bir ot türü olarak tanımlar. Hayvanların onu otlaması ve yapraklarının baş yıkamada kullanılması bitkinin kimliğini değiştirmeyen, ona bağlı kullanımlardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca bağımsız bitki adının yere yayılan ot anlamını verir; genel bitki, büyüme veya düzleştirme anlamı eklemez.

concept_map.definition: Toprak üzerinde yayılıp genişleyerek büyüyen belirli bir ot türüdür. Hayvanların otlaması ve yapraklarının baş yıkamada kullanılması, bu bitkiye bağlı ikincil kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Toprak üzerinde dik yükselmek yerine yayılarak büyüyen belirli bir ot türüdür.
Hayvanlar bu otu otlar ve yaprakları baş yıkamak için kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt, dalı yere yayılan bir ot türü olarak tanımlar; hayvanların otlaması ve yaprakların yıkamada kullanılması bu bitkinin ayırt edici kullanım bilgisidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bitki adını, onu ayırt eden toprak üzerinde yayılma biçimiyle doğal Türkçe olarak karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Bitki oluşunu, ot türünü ve yerde yayılarak büyüme biçimini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bitkinin dik büyümek yerine toprak yüzüne yayıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ot oluşunu ve yere yayılı büyüme biçimini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yere yayılan bitkinin hayvanlarca yenmesi özellikle belirtilmek istendiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yayılıcı büyümeyi ve hayvanların bu bitkiyi otlamasını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yere yayılarak büyüyen belirli bir otu ve bu ota bağlı kullanım bilgisini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ağaç olmayan taze ve yeşil bitkileri genel bir kategori olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da ağaç olmayan yeşil ve otumsu bir bitkiyi adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel ot ve taze bitki kategorisidir; bu dal yere yayılan belirli bir bitki türüyle sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli bir ot türünü, yerde yayılı büyüme biçimiyle adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ot, ekin ve ağacın topraktan çıkmasını ve genel bitkisel büyümeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da topraktan çıkan ve büyüyen bitkiler alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel bitki ve büyüme kavramıdır; bu dal ise yerde yayılan belirli bir otun adıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yayılma biçimini belirli bir bitki türünün kalıcı büyüme özelliği olarak taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Genel düz üst yüzeyi, düzleştirme işlemini ve herhangi bir şeyin genişlemesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir şeyin enine yayılarak geniş alan kaplaması düşüncesi bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yayılma özelliğiyle tanınan belirli bir bitkidir; komşu dal bitkiye özgü olmayan genel yüzey ve yayılma anlamıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel ot, genel bitkisel büyüme ve kökün temel yayılma dalı, tür ile üst kategori sınırını en iyi gösteren karşılaştırmalardır.
